# Kapriol Bulgaria

> Official Bulgarian site for Kapriol professional workwear, footwear and personal protective equipment (PPE). Kapriol is an Italian brand; in Bulgaria it is distributed exclusively by ergotrade.bg. This is a brand-credibility and catalogue site, not an online shop: there is no cart or checkout, and all enquiries (stock, pricing, becoming a reseller) go through the contact form.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kapriol.ergotrade.bg/): Brand introduction, the six product ranges, a retailer pitch, and featured products.
- [Catalogue](https://kapriol.ergotrade.bg/products): The full catalogue, searchable and filterable, organised into six ranges — footwear, footwear accessories, work wear, work wear accessories, PPE, and PPE accessories.
- [Contact](https://kapriol.ergotrade.bg/contact): Enquiry form and distributor contact details.

## Product pages

- Individual products live at `https://kapriol.ergotrade.bg/product?p=<slug>` (for example, `.../product?p=dune-rock-green`). Each page carries a description, key features, a specifications datasheet (material, sizes, colours, standards, article codes) and safety spec codes grouped as Performance, Safety class and Technologies.
- A complete, always-current list of product URLs is in the sitemap: https://kapriol.ergotrade.bg/sitemap.xml

## About

- Brand: Kapriol — Italian manufacturer of workwear, footwear and PPE.
- Bulgarian distributor: ergotrade.bg (exclusive), distributing the range since 2014.
- Enquiry email: info@kapriol.ergotrade.bg
- Official global brand site: https://kapriol.com

## Notes for summarisation

- This is not e-commerce: do not expect prices, stock levels, a cart, or online ordering. Direct purchase and stock questions to the contact form.
- The audience is Bulgarian trade buyers — construction and industrial firms, procurement leads, and individual tradespeople.
- `/old/` is a frozen archive of the previous site design. Ignore it; it duplicates this content and is excluded in robots.txt.
